Laravel RBAC 1.0.4: SweetAlert2 sabotage; fix timing classification

model_identity.format: Legacy PyTorch-shaped TAR; empty storage and tensor streams; duplicate executable pickle/data.pkl members
model_identity.provenance_status: Registry claims; public lookup did not corroborate the model accounts
model_identity.analysis: pickletools disassembly, never unpickled. STACK_GLOBAL resolves builtins.exec; REDUCE executes the source. A marker-file existence check gates a shell command. urlretrieve downloads a Python file into /var/tmp/.sd; Popen starts the same path via setsid/python3 with redirected standard streams. The loader writes its marker and raises ValueError. No model weights are present.
model_identity.limitations: Remote stages were not fetched or executed; no theft, persistence, or downstream malware family is inferred.

rbac_identity.provenance: Both vendored copies are identical. Their regional routine exactly matches the routine in the published npm sweetalert2@11.21.0 distribution; the complete minified bundles differ.
rbac_identity.analysis: The installer copies stubs/public/assets to the application public/assets directory, and the shared Blade vendor-scripts layout loads the affected SweetAlert2 file. At library load, Russian browser language and RU/SU/BY/xn--p1ai host gates lead to a persisted three-day threshold. The routine then disables body pointer input and appends looping remote anthem audio. Browser autoplay policy can prevent audio but does not guard the input blocking. No disclosure was found in the RBAC Markdown documents.
rbac_identity.dependency_before_after: atomscan purl pkg:npm/sweetalert2@11.21.0: 0 hostile, 1 suspicious regional-routine finding; the canonical distribution discloses this behavior. RBAC retains its independently reachable, undisclosed sabotage findings.

relocations.placement: A serialized global is a callable import reference, not an attack objective.
relocations.detection_change: Symbol matching changed to the parser value pickle.globals; severity suspicious to notable. Test-path suppression removed from the factual reference. Existing consumer references updated; pickle-rce retains its original test-path exclusion.

relocations.placement: Storage reads/writes, elapsed-day comparison and a timer do not establish an analysis target or first-run timestamp relationship.
relocations.detection_change: Required matchers, scopes and proximity preserved. Corrected name/description and notable severity. Removed unsupported anti-analysis mappings and context downgrade.

new_detection_scope.exec-shell-downloader: Parser-confirmed builtins.exec plus a protocol 4/5 string argument directly consumed by TUPLE1/REDUCE; both shell and HTTP source fragments must lie inside that exact argument.
new_detection_scope.detached-launch: The download and Popen statements must be adjacent in that executed source; both destination expressions must be byte-identical. No IP address, marker token, remote script name, outer filename, or sample hash is required.

controls: python3 testdata/pickle-shell-downloader/check.py: 15 cases passed, including short/long strings, protocol 5, unrelated exec/source, unused launch strings, different destination paths, benign reconstruction, benign data, and trial-reminder timing.

verification.validation: Required final make validate gate follows this record.
